subject: CareBright hosting path criteria and evidence plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@carebright.com>, Ryan Morales <ryan.morales@carebright.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up & evidence items from today

Hi Laura / Ryan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the hosting path and compliance asks: 

1) High-level constraint: CareBright will process PHI for scheduling reminders and summary notes (EHR-sourced). That makes a BAA required and SOC 2 evidence relevant. You indicated a preference for Dedicated capacity because predictability of latency and isolation is important for your clinician workflows, but the Security team asked about a Private VPC option if that reduces audit surface.

2) Items Redwood will provide (deliverables):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12-month) — initial copy for review
   - Draft BAA for legal review
   - Hosting comparison doc (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) focused on audit controls and evidence we can provide
   - Network diagram template + sample (so your infra team can confirm network controls)

3) Info we need from CareBright to finalize recommendation:
   - Estimated average QPS and peak concurrent sessions (tokens/minute is fine)
   - Confirmation of PHI fields we will receive/store (just a list of categories is OK)
   - Whether inbound/outbound connections must be limited to a static IP or VPC peering
   - Preferred timeline for go-live and any audit dates you are targeting

4) Proposed next steps and owners: 
   - I will upload the hosting comparison and fillable security questionnaire to the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow (owner: me).
   - Rishi will prepare a short evidence pack (SOC 2 excerpt, standard control mappings) by Thursday (owner: Rishi).
   - Laura / Ryan: please return the filled questionnaire and the network diagram (even a sketch) within 5 business days so we can validate hosting eligibility.

Attached: CareBright_Security_Questionnaire_FILLABLE.xlsx, Redwood_Hosting_Options_Comparative.pdf

If Dedicated is required for contractual reasons we will outline an onboarding timeline and reserved capacity estimates once we get traffic numbers. If the Security team prefers Private VPC, we can scope the additional network and infra steps — both are supported but have different lead times and costs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call with your Security lead if helpful.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@carebright.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Morales <ryan.morales@carebright.com>, security@carebright.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & evidence items from today

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do need a BAA in place before any PHI is exchanged.
- Our Security team (security@carebright.com) would prefer Private VPC if it simplifies our audit narrative, but they also indicated Dedicated would be acceptable if the SOC 2 controls and network isolation meet their checklist.
- Traffic: currently we're planning for ~10 QPS average with 45 QPS peak for the pilot workload; token-wise estimate ~120k tokens/day initially.
- PHI fields: name, DOB, appointment times, limited clinical notes (not full records).
- Network constraints: we need either static egress IPs or the ability to peer into our VPC (we will confirm which is preferred in the questionnaire).
- Target audit: we have a readiness review the week of 2026-11-29, so receiving SOC 2 excerpts and a draft BAA by 2026-11-09 would be ideal.

I will distribute the questionnaire to our security folks and aim to return it within 4 business days. Ryan is copied for timing. We are open to a 30-min follow-up with Rishi to review the evidence pack.

— Laura
Dr. Laura Chen
VP, Product & Partnerships | CareBright Health
laura.chen@carebright.com | +1 617-555-0120
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@carebright.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & evidence items from today

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the traffic and PHI details — that helps a lot. Based on the numbers you shared, Dedicated is likely the simplest path to meet your latency and isolation preferences with minimal network changes. Private VPC is doable but adds 2–4 weeks for network setup and approvals.

What I'll prepare for your review by 2026-11-06:
- SOC 2 Type II excerpt (controls mapping PDF)
- Draft BAA for legal intake (redline-friendly Word doc)
- Example network diagram and a short note on peering vs static IPs (one-page)
- Reserved capacity estimate and a cost delta comparison (Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Questions for the questionnaire we’ll highlight: whether you require inbound-only peering, egress-only static IPs, or full VPC peering; and whether log retention must be set at a particular window for audit purposes.

If Helpful: I can join a 30-min review with your Security lead on 11/09 or 11/10 — please let me know which day/time works.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Ryan Morales <ryan.morales@carebright.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@carebright.com>, security@carebright.com
Date: 2026-11-03T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & evidence items from today

Thanks Rishi — 11/09 at 10:00am ET works for our Security lead. We'll plan for the 30-min review to cover SOC 2 excerpt and networking options.

A couple of extra asks from our side so you can include them in the packet: 
- Sample SLA language around uptime and incident escalation for Dedicated customers.
- Data deletion/retention workflow for PHI (how Redwood ensures data removal after retention period).

I'll send over the completed questionnaire and a rough network sketch by Friday.

— Ryan
Ryan Morales
Director, Infrastructure | CareBright Health
ryan.morales@carebright.com | +1 415-555-0211

Subject: Re: Follow-up & evidence items from today — confirmed next steps

Great — thanks everyone for the quick responses and for confirming 11/09 10:00am ET for the security review. Finalizing next steps here so there is no ambiguity: 

Owners & timelines: 
- Karthik: upload hosting comparison + questionnaire to shared Drive (2026-11-03 EOD) — DONE (link above).
- Rishi: SOC 2 excerpt, draft BAA, network note, capacity estimate (deliver by 2026-11-06).
- CareBright (Laura / Ryan): return filled questionnaire and network sketch (by 2026-11-06 preferred).
- Security review call: 2026-11-09 10:00am ET (Rishi + CareBright security team).

Action items for the call: review SOC 2 mappings, discuss network options (static IP vs VPC peering), confirm whether Dedicated is contractually required or Private VPC is acceptable, and surface any additional audit evidence requests.

If anyone needs to shift the 11/09 slot, flag it by EOB Monday 11/08 so we can reschedule. Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up and getting you an onboarding plan.

— Karthik
